example: I found my glasses in the biscuit drawer.
translation: Ko‘zoynagimni pechenye tortmasidan topdim.

example: This little stool makes me tall enough to steal a biscuit.
translation: Bu kichik kursi pechenye o‘g‘irlashim uchun bo‘yimni yetarli qiladi.

example: Three coats are sitting on our hall bench.
translation: Dahlizdagi uzun o‘rindig‘imizda uchta palto o‘tiribdi.

example: We moved the furniture, but the cat wants it back.
translation: Mebelni ko‘chirdik, lekin mushuk uni avvalgi joyiga qaytarishimizni xohlaydi.

example: The kitchen clock says it is always lunchtime.
translation: Oshxonadagi soat doim tushlik vaqti ekanini ko‘rsatadi.

example: There are wooden spoons in my flower vase.
translation: Guldonimda yog‘och qoshiqlar turibdi.

example: That tiny duck ornament watches us eat.
translation: O‘sha mitti o‘rdak shaklidagi bezak ovqatlanishimizni kuzatadi.

example: The frame is beautiful, but the photo is upside down.
translation: Ramka chiroyli, lekin surat teskari turibdi.

example: This candle smells like cake, which feels unfair.
translation: Bu shamdan tort hidi keladi, bu esa adolatsizlikdek tuyuladi.

example: Our grand candlestick holds one tiny birthday candle.
translation: Hashamatli shamdonimizda tug‘ilgan kun uchun bitta mitti sham turibdi.

example: The dog sleeps by the fireplace like a little king.
translation: It kamin yonida kichkina qirol kabi uxlaydi.

example: My socks are having a warm holiday on the radiator.
translation: Paypoqlarim radiatorda issiq ta’til o‘tkazyapti.

example: The fan blows my shopping list across the room.
translation: Ventilyator xaridlar ro‘yxatimni xona bo‘ylab uchirib yuboradi.

example: Our television is huge, but we still lose the remote.
translation: Televizorimiz ulkan, ammo pultni baribir yo‘qotamiz.

example: The remote was under Dad all evening.
translation: Pult kech bo‘yi dadamning tagida edi.

example: Mum's old stereo still plays louder than we sing.
translation: Onamning eski musiqa qurilmasi hali ham bizning qo‘shig‘imizdan balandroq ovoz chiqaradi.

example: Use a coaster; the table dislikes tea rings.
translation: Piyola tagligini ishlating, stol choy izlarini yoqtirmaydi.

example: There is a pancake mark on the ceiling.
translation: Shiftda quymoq izi bor.

example: The stairs creak when I sneak down for cake.
translation: Tort yeyish uchun sekin tushganimda zinapoya g‘ichirlaydi.

example: Our hall is a small museum of muddy shoes.
translation: Dahlizimiz loy oyoq kiyimlarning kichik muzeyi.

example: A lonely slipper waits on the landing.
translation: Zina maydonchasida bitta yolg‘iz shippak kutib turibdi.

example: We grow herbs on the balcony and call it a farm.
translation: Balkonda ko‘kat yetishtiramiz va uni ferma deymiz.

example: Our basement contains three broken fans and a dream.
translation: Yerto‘lamizda uchta buzilgan ventilyator va bir orzu bor.

example: I went into the attic and found Mum's disco shoes.
translation: Chordoqqa chiqib, onamning diskoteka tuflisini topdim.

example: The garage is full, so the car lives outside.
translation: Garaj to‘la, shuning uchun mashina tashqarida yashaydi.

example: Grandma keeps a chair on the porch for serious gossip.
translation: Buvim muhim g‘iybatlar uchun ayvonda kursi saqlaydi.

example: Our gate makes a louder noise than the doorbell.
translation: Darvozamiz eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘idan ham balandroq ovoz chiqaradi.

example: The cat crosses our fence without asking.
translation: Mushuk panjaramizdan so‘ramasdan oshib o‘tadi.

example: There is a flowerpot on every step except mine.
translation: Men turganidan boshqa har bir zina pog‘onasida gultuvak bor.

example: The door handle is sticky after our jam party.
translation: Murabbo ziyofatimizdan keyin eshik tutqichi yopishqoq bo‘lib qolgan.

example: This lock protects a cupboard full of boring towels.
translation: Bu qulf zerikarli sochiqlar bilan to‘la javonni qo‘riqlaydi.

example: My key was in the pocket I checked three times.
translation: Kalitim uch marta tekshirgan cho‘ntagimda ekan.

example: The doorbell rang just as I put on a face mask.
translation: Yuzimga niqob surtganim zahoti eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘i chalindi.

example: Our doormat says welcome, but the cat looks doubtful.
translation: Eshik gilamchamizda xush kelibsiz deb yozilgan, lekin mushuk shubha bilan qaraydi.

example: The only free socket is behind a very heavy sofa.
translation: Yagona bo‘sh rozetka juda og‘ir divan ortida.

example: I checked the plug before blaming the kettle.
translation: Choynakni ayblashdan oldin elektr vilkasini tekshirdim.

example: This switch turns on the hall light, not the moon.
translation: Bu o‘chirgich oyni emas, dahliz chirog‘ini yoqadi.

example: We changed the bulb and discovered more dust.
translation: Lampochkani almashtirib, yana ko‘proq changni ko‘rdik.

example: The tap drips like a very slow drummer.
translation: Jo‘mrak juda sekin barabanchi kabi tomchilaydi.

example: That pipe makes strange noises after my shower.
translation: Dush qabul qilganimdan keyin o‘sha quvur g‘alati ovoz chiqaradi.

example: The heating is on, and the cat has melted onto the rug.
translation: Isitish tizimi yoqilgan, mushuk esa gilamchaga yoyilib yotibdi.

example: The air conditioning makes our bedroom feel like a fridge.
translation: Havoni sovitish tizimi yotoqxonamizni muzlatkichdek qiladi.

example: My pillow knows all my weekend plans: sleep.
translation: Yostig‘im dam olish kunidagi barcha rejalarimni biladi: uxlash.

example: This pillowcase has little dancing carrots on it.
translation: Bu yostiq jildida raqsga tushayotgan mitti sabzilar tasviri bor.

example: The sheet is clean until the dog says hello.
translation: It salom berguncha choyshab toza turadi.

example: We share a blanket, but my brother takes the warm half.
translation: Biz bitta adyolni bo‘lishamiz, ammo ukam issiq yarmini oladi.

example: Getting out from under this duvet is my hardest job.
translation: Bu ko‘rpa tagidan chiqish mening eng qiyin ishim.

example: Our new mattress arrived in a box smaller than Dad.
translation: Yangi matrasimiz dadamdan kichikroq qutida keldi.

example: The fancy bedspread hides my untidy sheets.
translation: Bezakli yopinchiq tartibsiz choyshablarimni yashiradi.

example: Fresh bedding makes Monday feel slightly kinder.
translation: Yangi yuvilgan ko‘rpa-to‘shak anjomlari dushanbani biroz yoqimliroq qiladi.

example: My brother calls the top of the bunk bed his castle.
translation: Ukam ikki qavatli karavotning yuqorisini o‘z qal’asi deydi.

example: The baby sleeps in a cot surrounded by toy bears.
translation: Chaqaloq o‘yinchoq ayiqlar qurshovidagi karavotida uxlaydi.

example: My bedside table holds water and seven unfinished books.
translation: Karavotim yonidagi tumbada suv va yettita tugatilmagan kitob bor.

example: My alarm clock is the loudest member of the family.
translation: Budilnigim oilamizning eng shovqinli a’zosi.

example: I have ten hangers and eleven coats; one coat is sad.
translation: Menda o‘nta ilgich va o‘n bitta palto bor; bitta palto xafa.

example: The hook behind the door holds my entire winter.
translation: Eshik ortidagi ilgakda qishki kiyimlarimning hammasi osilib turibdi.

example: The chest of drawers is full of socks without partners.
translation: Tortmali kiyim javoni jufti yo‘q paypoqlarga to‘la.

example: The bath is ready, and so is my rubber duck.
translation: Vanna tayyor, rezina o‘rdagim ham tayyor.

example: My brother sings in the shower; the pipes complain.
translation: Akam dushda qo‘shiq aytadi; quvurlar shikoyat qiladi.

example: Our toilet has a warmer seat than my office chair.
translation: Unitazimizning o‘rindig‘i idoradagi kursimnikidan issiqroq.

example: The bathroom basin is too small for our dramatic cat.
translation: Hammomdagi yuz-qo‘l yuvgich o‘zini ko‘z-ko‘z qiladigan mushugimiz uchun juda kichik.

example: Someone used my best towel to dry the dog.
translation: Kimdir eng yaxshi sochig‘im bilan itni quritibdi.

example: The wet bathmat feels like a cold pancake.
translation: Ho‘l hammom gilamchasi sovuq quymoqqa o‘xshaydi.

example: This yellow sponge works harder than anyone in the bathroom.
translation: Bu sariq gubka hammomdagi hammadan ko‘proq ishlaydi.

example: My ring nearly went down the drain during its bath.
translation: Uzugimni yuvayotganda u suv teshigiga tushib ketay dedi.

example: One bathroom tile has a duck on it for company.
translation: Hammomdagi bir kafelda hamroh bo‘lsin deb o‘rdak rasmi tushirilgan.

example: Buying toilet paper is less exciting than buying cake.
translation: Hojatxona qog‘ozi sotib olish tort olishdek qiziq emas.

example: This bowl is large enough for my breakfast dreams.
translation: Bu kosa nonushta haqidagi orzularim uchun yetarlicha katta.

example: My mug says boss, but Mum gives the orders.
translation: Krujkamda boshliq deb yozilgan, lekin buyruqni onam beradi.

example: The biscuit on my saucer disappeared during one phone call.
translation: Bitta telefon suhbati davomida likopchamdagi pechenye yo‘qoldi.

example: He poured juice into a glass bigger than his breakfast.
translation: U sharbatni nonushtasidan kattaroq stakanga quydi.

example: The jug is full of lemonade and ambitious lemon slices.
translation: Ko‘za limonad va juda katta limon bo‘laklariga to‘la.

example: Our teapot wears a little woolly hat.
translation: Choy damlaydigan choynagimiz kichik jun qalpoq kiygan.

example: I ate the ice cream with a teaspoon to make it last.
translation: Muzqaymoq uzoqroqqa yetsin deb uni choy qoshiqda yedim.

example: Use one tablespoon of honey, not the whole jar.
translation: Butun bankani emas, bir osh qoshiq asal ishlating.

example: My chopsticks keep dropping noodles onto my shirt.
translation: Tayoqchalarim ugra bo‘laklarini ko‘ylagimga tushiraveradi.

example: We packed the picnic but forgot all the cutlery.
translation: Sayr ovqatini joyladik, lekin barcha qoshiq, sanchqi va pichoqlarni unutdik.

example: The serving dish is empty, so dinner was a success.
translation: Ovqat tortilgan idish bo‘sh, demak kechki ovqat yaxshi chiqibdi.

example: I carried breakfast on a tray like a nervous waiter.
translation: Nonushtani hayajonlangan ofitsiantdek patnisda olib keldim.

example: The pan is hot, but my cooking ideas are not.
translation: Tova issiq, ammo ovqat pishirish g‘oyalarim unchalik zo‘r emas.

example: Our smallest saucepan makes exactly one lonely portion.
translation: Eng kichik kastryulkamizda rosa bir kishilik ovqat pishadi.

example: This frying pan has seen more eggs than a farm.
translation: Bu qovurish tovasi fermadan ham ko‘proq tuxum ko‘rgan.

example: The lid fits every pot except the right one.
translation: Qopqoq o‘z qozonidan boshqa hamma qozonga tushadi.

example: Dad uses a ladle because his idea of a spoon is big.
translation: Dadamning qoshiq haqidagi tasavvuri katta bo‘lgani uchun u cho‘mich ishlatadi.

example: The spatula rescued my pancake from a sticky end.
translation: Kurakcha quymog‘imni yopishib qolishdan qutqardi.

example: The whisk left cream on my nose and nowhere useful.
translation: Ko‘pirtirgich qaymoqni kerakli joyga emas, burnimga sachratdi.

example: The grater turned a large cheese block into a tiny mountain.
translation: Qirg‘ich katta pishloq bo‘lagini kichik tog‘chaga aylantirdi.

example: This peeler gives every potato a quick haircut.
translation: Bu po‘st archgich har bir kartoshkaning sochini tezda olib qo‘yadi.

example: Flour went through the sieve and onto my black trousers.
translation: Un elakdan o‘tib, qora shimimga tushdi.

example: The colander lets the water escape but keeps dinner safe.
translation: Suzgich suvni chiqarib yuboradi, ammo ovqatni saqlab qoladi.

example: My chopping board smells of garlic, whatever I cut.
translation: Nima kesishimdan qat’i nazar, taxtamdan sarimsoq hidi keladi.

example: Grandma uses a rolling pin; I just watch and eat.
translation: Buvim o‘qlov ishlatadi, men esa faqat kuzataman va yeyman.

example: The oven is ready, but the cake is still an idea.
translation: Duxovka tayyor, ammo tort hali faqat g‘oya.

example: The microwave finished lunch before I found a fork.
translation: Sanchqi topgunimcha mikroto‘lqinli pech tushlikni isitib bo‘ldi.

example: Our kettle works harder when Grandma visits.
translation: Buvim kelganida suv choynagimiz ko‘proq ishlaydi.

example: The toaster frightened me by throwing up my breakfast.
translation: Non qizartirgich nonushtamni yuqoriga otib meni qo‘rqitdi.

example: The blender turned my fruit into a pink breakfast.
translation: Blender mevalarimni pushti nonushtaga aylantirdi.

example: Our mixer is loud enough to announce cake to the neighbours.
translation: Mikserimizning ovozi qo‘shnilarga tort pishayotganini bildirishga yetadi.

example: The freezer contains peas and my emergency ice cream.
translation: Muzlatish kamerasida no‘xat va zarurat uchun saqlagan muzqaymog‘im bor.

example: I thanked the dishwasher after our twelve-person dinner.
translation: O‘n ikki kishilik kechki ovqatdan so‘ng idish yuvish mashinasiga rahmat aytdim.

example: The sink is full of dishes having a long bath.
translation: Oshxona chig‘anog‘i uzoq cho‘milayotgan idishlarga to‘la.

example: Flour covers the worktop like very expensive snow.
translation: Oshxona ish yuzasini juda qimmat qordek un qoplagan.

example: The kitchen scales say my small snack weighs half a kilo.
translation: Oshxona tarozisi kichik gazagim yarim kilo kelishini ko‘rsatmoqda.

example: Set the timer before the biscuits become little rocks.
translation: Pechenyelar mayda toshlarga aylanishidan oldin taymerni qo‘ying.

example: We brought beans on holiday but no tin opener.
translation: Ta’tilga loviya konservasini oldik, ammo konserva ochgich olmabmiz.

example: The bottle opener is hiding whenever I want lemonade.
translation: Limonad ichmoqchi bo‘lganimda shisha ochgich yashirinib oladi.

example: This bottle holds water, despite its fancy label.
translation: Chiroyli yorlig‘iga qaramay, bu shishada oddiy suv bor.

example: Grandma keeps buttons in an old jam jar.
translation: Buvim tugmalarni eski murabbo bankasida saqlaydi.

example: The biscuit tin contains sewing things again.
translation: Pechenye qutisida yana tikuv buyumlari turibdi.

example: Every container has a lid, just never the one I find.
translation: Har bir idishning qopqog‘i bor, faqat men topgan qopqoq unga tushmaydi.

example: My lunchbox is so full that the sandwich needs a seat belt.
translation: Tushlik qutim shunchalik to‘laki, sendvichga xavfsizlik kamari kerak.

example: The bread basket is empty, and Dad looks innocent.
translation: Non savati bo‘sh, dadam esa o‘zini aybsizdek tutyapti.

example: I wrapped the potato in foil like a tiny present.
translation: Kartoshkani mitti sovg‘adek zarqog‘ozga o‘radim.

example: The cling film sticks to me better than to the bowl.
translation: O‘rash plyonkasi kosadan ko‘ra menga yaxshiroq yopishadi.

example: He tucked a napkin into his shirt before the tomato soup.
translation: U pomidor sho‘rvasini ichishdan oldin yoqasiga salfetka qistirdi.

example: Our white tablecloth remembers every family dinner.
translation: Oq dasturxonimiz har bir oilaviy kechki ovqatni eslaydi.

example: Dad wears an apron to protect his shirt from his cooking.
translation: Dadam ko‘ylagini o‘zining pazandaligidan himoya qilish uchun fartuk kiyadi.

example: The broom is for the floor, not for flying to the shops.
translation: Supurgi do‘konga uchish uchun emas, pol uchun.

example: This stiff brush can finally clean my muddy boots.
translation: Bu qattiq cho‘tka nihoyat loy etiklarimni tozalay oladi.

example: The last crumb refuses to enter the dustpan.
translation: Oxirgi ushoq xokandozga kirishni istamayapti.

example: The mop has wetter hair than I do after a shower.
translation: Pol artgichning sochi dushdan keyingi sochimdan ham ho‘lroq.

example: I filled the bucket and immediately wished it had wheels.
translation: Chelakni to‘ldirib, darhol uning g‘ildiraklari bo‘lishini istadim.

example: The vacuum cleaner eats crumbs and frightens the cat.
translation: Changyutkich ushoqlarni yeydi va mushukni qo‘rqitadi.

example: My duster has discovered a grey world behind the television.
translation: Chang lattam televizor ortidan kulrang dunyo topdi.

example: Use a damp cloth; your sleeve is not a cleaning tool.
translation: Nam latta ishlating, yengingiz tozalash asbobi emas.

example: Dad's old shirt is now a very proud cleaning rag.
translation: Dadamning eski ko‘ylagi endi juda mag‘rur tozalash lattasi.

example: This detergent smells of flowers I have never met.
translation: Bu yuvish vositasidan men hech uchratmagan gullarning hidi keladi.

example: A little washing-up liquid makes a mountain of bubbles.
translation: Ozgina idish yuvish suyuqligi bir tog‘ ko‘pik hosil qiladi.

example: Mum keeps the bleach high up, far from curious hands.
translation: Onam oqartiruvchi vositani qiziquvchan qo‘llardan uzoqda, yuqorida saqlaydi.

example: The furniture polish makes our old table look important.
translation: Mebelga jilo beruvchi vosita eski stolimizni salobatli ko‘rsatadi.

example: The bin is full, but nobody wants to be the first to notice.
translation: Axlat chelagi to‘la, ammo hech kim buni birinchi bo‘lib payqashni istamaydi.

example: This bin bag is carrying the remains of our party.
translation: Bu axlat paketida ziyofatimizdan qolgan chiqindilar bor.

example: Please take the rubbish out before it starts a new life.
translation: Axlat yangi hayot boshlamasidan oldin uni tashqariga olib chiqing.

example: There is enough dust on this shelf to write my name.
translation: Bu tokchada ismimni yozishga yetadigan chang bor.

example: The stain on my shirt looks exactly like Italy.
translation: Ko‘ylagimdagi dog‘ xuddi Italiyaga o‘xshaydi.

example: Our washing machine dances when it washes towels.
translation: Kir yuvish mashinamiz sochiq yuvganda raqsga tushadi.

example: The iron is ready for a battle with my shirt.
translation: Dazmol ko‘ylagim bilan jang qilishga tayyor.

example: The ironing board squeaks louder than our front gate.
translation: Dazmol taxtasi old darvozamizdan ham balandroq g‘ichirlaydi.

example: One brave peg is holding up Dad's enormous trousers.
translation: Bitta jasur kir qisqichi dadamning ulkan shimini ushlab turibdi.

example: Our clothesline displays the family's favourite colours.
translation: Kir arqonimiz oilamizning sevimli ranglarini namoyish qiladi.

example: The laundry pile grows while I am not looking.
translation: Men qaramaganimda kir uyumi kattalashadi.

example: The tumble dryer returned my jumper in a smaller size.
translation: Kir quritish mashinasi jemperimni kichikroq o‘lchamda qaytardi.

example: I sweep the kitchen while the dog supplies more crumbs.
translation: Men oshxonani supuraman, it esa yana ushoq yetkazib beradi.

example: Wipe the table before your elbows stick to it.
translation: Tirsaklaringiz yopishib qolmasidan oldin stolni arting.

example: We scrubbed the pan until it finally forgave us.
translation: Tova nihoyat bizni kechirguncha uni ishqalab tozaladik.

example: Rinse the mug unless you enjoy tea with soap.
translation: Sovunli choyni yoqtirmasangiz, krujkani chaying.

example: I soak dirty dishes while I gather the courage to wash them.
translation: Yuvishga jur’at yig‘gunimcha kir idishlarni ivitib qo‘yaman.

example: Dry the plates before they create a lake in the cupboard.
translation: Javonda ko‘l hosil qilmasidan oldin likopchalarni quriting.

example: I fold towels into squares; Dad makes mysterious shapes.
translation: Men sochiqlarni to‘rtburchak qilib taxlayman, dadam esa sirli shakllar yasaydi.

example: Hang your coat on the hook, not on your little brother.
translation: Paltoyingizni ukangizga emas, ilgakka osing.

example: We tidy up before guests discover our real lifestyle.
translation: Mehmonlar haqiqiy turmush tarzimizni bilib qolmasidan oldin yig‘ishtiramiz.

example: Put away the clean socks before the cat adopts them.
translation: Toza paypoqlarni mushuk o‘ziniki qilib olmasidan oldin joyiga qo‘ying.

example: Who will wash up after my famous three-pan breakfast?
translation: Mening mashhur uch tovalik nonushtamdan keyin idishlarni kim yuvadi?

example: Let's clear up before Mum sees our flour mountain.
translation: Onam un tog‘imizni ko‘rmasidan oldin yig‘ishtiraylik.

example: Don't throw away that box; the cat has moved in.
translation: U qutini tashlab yubormang, mushuk unga ko‘chib kirgan.

example: Please pick up your socks; the floor wants a rest.
translation: Iltimos, paypoqlaringizni terib oling, pol dam olmoqchi.

example: I sort the laundry while my brother sorts the snacks.
translation: Men kirlarni saralayman, akam esa gazaklarni saralaydi.

example: Separate white clothes from red ones unless you want pink socks.
translation: Pushti paypoq xohlamasangiz, oq kiyimlarni qizillaridan ajrating.

example: Empty the bin before the lid gives up.
translation: Qopqoq taslim bo‘lmasidan oldin axlat chelagini bo‘shating.

example: Fill the kettle, but leave some water for the rest of us.
translation: Choynakni to‘ldiring, lekin qolganlarimizga ham suv qoldiring.

example: Dad repaired the chair, and now it has one extra screw.
translation: Dadam kursini ta’mirladi, endi esa bitta vint ortib qoldi.

example: Grandma mended my sock with bright orange thread.
translation: Buvim paypog‘imni yorqin to‘q sariq ip bilan yamadi.

example: We replaced the broken lamp before another dark dinner.
translation: Yana qorong‘ida ovqatlanmaslik uchun singan chiroqni almashtirdik.

example: Unplug the iron before we go; it isn't coming with us.
translation: Ketishdan oldin dazmolni rozetkadan uzing, u biz bilan bormaydi.

example: Switch on the fan before we all turn into soup.
translation: Hammamiz sho‘rvaga aylanmasimizdan oldin ventilyatorni yoqing.

example: Switch off the light; the furniture can sleep in the dark.
translation: Chiroqni o‘chiring, mebel qorong‘ida ham uxlay oladi.

example: My favourite chore is testing whether the biscuits are fresh.
translation: Sevimli uy yumushim pechenyelar yangiligini tekshirish.

example: Boil the potatoes until they stop being little stones.
translation: Kartoshkalarni mayda tosh bo‘lmay qolguncha qaynating.

example: Dad fries eggs as if he is on a cooking show.
translation: Dadam tuxumni pazandalik ko‘rsatuvidagidek qovuradi.

example: We bake biscuits whenever the house needs a better smell.
translation: Uyga yoqimliroq hid kerak bo‘lsa, pechenye pishiramiz.

example: Roast the vegetables until they are brown, not until they look like coal.
translation: Sabzavotlarni ko‘mirga o‘xshaguncha emas, qizarguncha duxovkada pishiring.

example: I grill peppers while Dad gives expert advice from his chair.
translation: Men qalampirlarni grilda pishiraman, dadam esa kursidan mutaxassis maslahatlarini beradi.

example: We steam broccoli, but my brother still looks suspicious.
translation: Biz brokkolini bug‘da pishiramiz, ammo ukam baribir shubha bilan qaraydi.

example: Heat the soup before it forgets it is dinner.
translation: Sho‘rva kechki ovqat ekanini unutmasidan oldin uni isiting.

example: I peel apples in one long strip and feel very clever.
translation: Olmalarning po‘stini bitta uzun tasma qilib archib, o‘zimni juda aqlli his qilaman.

example: Chop the onion before it makes you tell a sad story.
translation: Piyoz sizga qayg‘uli hikoya ayttirmasidan oldin uni to‘g‘rang.

example: Slice the bread thinly; this sandwich is already a tower.
translation: Nonni yupqa tilimlang, bu sendvich allaqachon minoraga aylangan.

example: Cut the cake fairly; everyone is watching your knife.
translation: Tortni teng bo‘lib kesing, hamma pichog‘ingizni kuzatyapti.

example: I grate cheese until the pasta disappears underneath it.
translation: Makaron tagida ko‘rinmay qolguncha pishloqni qirg‘ichdan o‘tkazaman.

example: Mix the flour slowly unless you want a white kitchen.
translation: Oq oshxona xohlamasangiz, unni sekin aralashtiring.

example: Stir the sauce while I rescue the toast.
translation: Men qizargan nonni qutqargunimcha qaylani aralashtirib turing.

example: Pour the milk slowly; my breakfast does not need a flood.

translation: To‘p kichik amakivachchamdan balandroq sapchiy oladi.

example: We warm up before our very short run.
translation: Juda qisqa yugurishimizdan oldin badan qizdiramiz.

example: We set off early and forgot the tent.
translation: Erta yo‘lga chiqib, chodirni unutdik.

example: We get lost whenever Dad says he knows.
translation: Dadam yo‘lni bilaman deganida har safar adashamiz.

example: Fishing gives Grandpa an excuse to sit quietly.
translation: Baliq ovlash bobomga jim o‘tirish uchun bahona beradi.

example: Birdwatching is difficult with my sneezing brother.
translation: Aksirayotgan ukam bilan qush kuzatish qiyin.

example: My leisure time begins when the dishes are clean.
translation: Bo‘sh vaqtim idishlar tozalanganda boshlanadi.

example: I relax best where nobody can find the vacuum.
translation: Hech kim changyutgichni topolmaydigan joyda yaxshi dam olaman.

example: After our holiday, Dad needed a rest.
translation: Ta’tildan keyin dadamga dam kerak bo‘ldi.

example: We had fun even when the kite escaped.
translation: Varrak qochib ketganda ham maza qildik.

example: Eating outdoors means sharing lunch with curious ants.
translation: Ochiq havoda ovqatlanish tushlikni qiziquvchan chumolilar bilan bo‘lishishdir.

example: We played indoors after the rain won.
translation: Yomg‘ir yutgach, bino ichida o‘ynadik.

example: Dad tried to sunbathe under an enormous umbrella.
translation: Dadam ulkan soyabon ostida quyoshga toblanmoqchi bo‘ldi.

example: We snorkel to meet fish without knocking.
translation: Baliqlar bilan eshik taqillatmay uchrashish uchun naycha bilan suzamiz.

example: My skateboard moves faster when I fall off.
translation: Skeytbordim men yiqilganda tezroq yuradi.

example: The kite preferred the tree to the sky.
translation: Varrak osmondan ko‘ra daraxtni afzal ko‘rdi.

example: Grandma chose the swing before the children arrived.
translation: Buvim bolalar kelmasidan arg‘imchoqni tanladi.

example: The slide made my little cousin's hair stand up.
translation: Sirpanib tushganda kichik amakivachchamning sochi tik bo‘ldi.

example: The seesaw works better without Dad on one end.
translation: Bir uchida dadam bo‘lmasa, arg‘imchoq yaxshiroq ishlaydi.

example: Our playground has no room for adult worries.
translation: O‘yin maydonchamizda kattalarning tashvishlariga joy yo‘q.

example: The amusement park made Dad scream like a child.
translation: Attraksionlar bog‘ida dadam boladek qichqirdi.

example: This theme park has dinosaurs selling ice cream.
translation: Bu mavzuli bog‘da dinozavrlar muzqaymoq sotadi.

example: We left the funfair with an enormous teddy.
translation: Attraksionlar saylidan ulkan o‘yinchoq ayiq bilan qaytdik.

example: The roller coaster rearranged my carefully combed hair.
translation: Tezkor attraksion tartibli taralgan sochimni qayta turmakladi.

example: The Ferris wheel showed us everyone's colourful hats.
translation: Charxpalak bizga hammaning rang-barang shlyapalarini ko‘rsatdi.

example: Our sandcastle had a garage but no roof.
translation: Qum qal’amizda garaj bor edi, lekin tom yo‘q edi.

example: Getting into the hammock was my daily exercise.
translation: Osma belanchakka chiqish kunlik mashqim bo‘ldi.

example: The frisbee landed on our sleeping uncle.
translation: Uloqtirilgan disk uxlayotgan amakimiz ustiga tushdi.

example: The paddling pool was perfect for Dad's tired feet.
translation: Bolalar hovuzi dadamning charchagan oyoqlariga ayni muddao edi.

example: The deckchair folded before I finished sitting down.
translation: O‘tirib bo‘lmasimdan yig‘ma kursi yig‘ilib qoldi.

example: The waterslide delivered me without my brave expression.
translation: Suvli attraksiondan tushganda yuzimdagi jasorat yo‘qolgan edi.

example: Education does not end when the school bell rings.
translation: Maktab qo‘ng‘irog‘i chalinganda ta’lim tugamaydi.

example: One pupil brought a pumpkin instead of a football.
translation: Bir o‘quvchi futbol to‘pi o‘rniga qovoq olib keldi.

example: My brother studies cooking at college and experiments on us.
translation: Akam kollejda oshpazlikni o‘rganadi va bizda tajriba o‘tkazadi.

example: At university, she discovered both physics and instant noodles.
translation: Universitetda u ham fizikani, ham tezpishar ugra taomini kashf etdi.

example: The campus has three cafés and one very popular cat.
translation: Universitet hududida uchta kafe va bitta juda mashhur mushuk bor.

example: I joined a photography course to improve my blurry pictures.
translation: Xira suratlarimni yaxshilash uchun fotografiya kursiga yozildim.

example: History is her favourite subject because people made such strange decisions.
translation: Tarix uning sevimli fani, chunki odamlar juda g‘alati qarorlar qabul qilishgan.

example: This term, our class will finally learn where commas belong.
translation: Bu semestr sinfimiz nihoyat vergullar qayerga qo‘yilishini o‘rganadi.

example: She gives maths tuition using biscuits that rarely survive the lesson.
translation: U dars oxirigacha kamdan-kam saqlanadigan pechenyelar yordamida matematikadan xususiy dars beradi.

example: During the break, even our strict teacher tells jokes.
translation: Tanaffusda hatto qattiqqo‘l o‘qituvchimiz ham hazil aytadi.

example: At assembly, the microphone made the headteacher sound like a duck.
translation: Umumiy yig‘ilishda mikrofon direktorning ovozini o‘rdaknikiga o‘xshatib qo‘ydi.

example: Our headteacher knows every pupil and most of their excuses.
translation: Maktab direktorimiz har bir o‘quvchini va ularning aksariyat bahonalarini biladi.

example: My tutor explains fractions with pizza, which keeps me interested.
translation: Ustozim kasrlarni pitsa yordamida tushuntiradi, shuning uchun qiziqishim so‘nmaydi.

example: A classmate lent me a ruler longer than my arm.
translation: Bir sinfdoshim menga qo‘limdan uzunroq chizg‘ich berib turdi.

example: Every learner needs practice, including my very confused parrot.
translation: Har bir o‘rganuvchiga, jumladan, juda gangib qolgan to‘tiqushimga ham mashq kerak.

example: As a beginner, I could only introduce myself to the computer.
translation: Boshlovchi sifatida men kompyuterga faqat o‘zimni tanishtira olardim.

example: The next level includes longer texts and fewer pictures of cats.
translation: Keyingi darajada uzunroq matnlar va mushuklarning kamroq rasmlari bor.

example: The new staff receive training before touching the mysterious machine.
translation: Yangi xodimlar sirli uskunaga tegishdan oldin tayyorgarlikdan o‘tadi.

example: We built a tiny bridge during the engineering workshop.
translation: Muhandislik bo‘yicha amaliy seminarda kichkina ko‘prik qurdik.

example: The lecture on sleep kept everyone surprisingly awake.
translation: Uyqu haqidagi ma’ruza, ajablanarlisi, hammani hushyor tutdi.

example: Our seminar became lively when someone mentioned homework for teachers.
translation: Kimdir o‘qituvchilar uchun uy vazifasini tilga olganda seminarimiz jonlanib ketdi.

example: Attendance improved after the club started offering biscuits.
translation: To‘garak pechenye bera boshlagach, davomat yaxshilandi.

example: The teacher checked the register while two late pupils tried to look invisible.
translation: Ikki kechikkan o‘quvchi ko‘rinmas bo‘lishga urinayotganda o‘qituvchi davomat ro‘yxatini tekshirdi.

example: She won a scholarship and bought her lucky pencil a new case.
translation: U stipendiya yutib oldi va omadli qalamiga yangi qalamdon sotib oldi.

example: When I graduate, my alarm clock deserves a holiday.
translation: O‘qishni tamomlaganimda, budilnigim ta’tilga loyiq bo‘ladi.

example: Maths helps me divide a cake without starting an argument.
translation: Matematika tortni janjalsiz bo‘lishimga yordam beradi.

example: In science, we asked why toast always seems to land butter down.
translation: Tabiiy fanlar darsida nega qovurilgan non doim yog‘li tomoni bilan tushgandek bo‘lishini so‘radik.

example: History would be easier if kings chose different names.
translation: Qirollar har xil ism tanlaganida, tarix osonroq bo‘lardi.

example: In algebra, we spend a surprising amount of time looking for x.
translation: Algebrada x ni qidirishga hayratlanarli darajada ko‘p vaqt sarflaymiz.

example: Our biology teacher introduced a worm as today's special guest.
translation: Biologiya o‘qituvchimiz chuvalchangni bugungi maxsus mehmon deb tanishtirdi.

example: In chemistry, we learnt why random liquids should not become soup.
translation: Kimyoda duch kelgan suyuqliklardan nega sho‘rva qilib bo‘lmasligini o‘rgandik.

example: Physics explains why my paper plane keeps attacking the floor.
translation: Fizika qog‘oz samolyotim nega doim polga hujum qilishini tushuntiradi.

example: Literature gives us heroes who have worse Mondays than we do.
translation: Adabiyot bizga dushanbasi biznikidan ham yomonroq o‘tadigan qahramonlarni beradi.

example: In art, my portrait looked more like a potato than a person.
translation: Tasviriy san’at darsida chizgan portretim odamdan ko‘ra kartoshkaga ko‘proq o‘xshadi.

example: Drama taught our quietest pupil to shout like a king.
translation: Teatr san’ati eng kamgap o‘quvchimizga qirol kabi baqirishni o‘rgatdi.

example: He studies economics but still cannot explain his biscuit budget.
translation: U iqtisodiyotni o‘rganadi, lekin pechenye uchun ajratgan pulini hali ham izohlay olmaydi.

example: Our computing course began with passwords, not building a robot butler.
translation: Kompyuter kursimiz robot xizmatkor yaratishdan emas, parollardan boshlandi.

example: During PE, I ran fastest when the ball came towards me.
translation: Jismoniy tarbiya darsida to‘p menga qarab kelganda eng tez yugurdim.

example: Her knowledge of dinosaurs makes museum visits very long.
translation: Uning dinozavrlar haqidagi bilimi muzey sayrlarini juda uzaytiradi.

example: One surprising fact can wake up a sleepy class.
translation: Bitta hayratlanarli ma’lumot uyqusiragan sinfni uyg‘otishi mumkin.

example: His idea for silent crisps impressed the whole library.
translation: Uning ovozsiz chips haqidagi g‘oyasi kutubxonadagilarning barchasini qoyil qoldirdi.

example: We discussed a theory about how children learn, then asked an actual child.
translation: Bolalar qanday o‘rganishi haqidagi nazariyani muhokama qildik, keyin haqiqiy boladan so‘radik.

example: The first rule of the lab is that nothing counts as lunch.
translation: Laboratoriyaning birinchi qoidasi: hech narsa tushlik hisoblanmaydi.

example: I remembered the formula but forgot where I put my calculator.
translation: Formulani esladim, lekin kalkulyatorimni qayerga qo‘yganimni unutdim.

example: A fraction of the cake remained after our maths demonstration.
translation: Matematika namoyishimizdan keyin tortning bir bo‘lagi qoldi.

example: What percentage of your notes is actually drawings of spaceships?
translation: Qaydlaringizning necha foizi aslida kosmik kemalar rasmlaridan iborat?

example: My calculation says we need twelve pizzas for four people.
translation: Hisob-kitobimga ko‘ra, to‘rt kishiga o‘n ikkita pitsa kerak.

example: We practised addition with buttons until one rolled under the cupboard.
translation: Bitta tugma javon tagiga dumalab ketguncha tugmalar bilan qo‘shish amalini mashq qildik.

example: Subtraction became real when my brother ate three of my sweets.
translation: Ukam uchta konfetimni yeganda ayirish amali hayotiy tus oldi.

example: Division is easier when nobody eats the teaching materials.
translation: Hech kim dars materiallarini yeb qo‘ymasa, bo‘lish amali osonroq bo‘ladi.

example: My textbook has more sticky notes than actual pages.
translation: Darsligimda sahifalardan ham ko‘proq yopishqoq qayd qog‘ozlari bor.

example: The workbook looked friendly until page forty.
translation: Mashq daftari qirqinchi betgacha do‘stona ko‘rindi.

example: A breeze took my worksheet on an unexpected school trip.
translation: Shamol topshiriqlar varag‘imni kutilmagan maktab sayohatiga olib ketdi.

example: The handout explains everything except where I left the handout.
translation: Tarqatma material hamma narsani tushuntiradi, faqat uni qayerda qoldirganimni emas.

example: Someone drew a tiny crown on the whiteboard above my name.
translation: Kimdir oq taxtada ismim tepasiga kichkina toj chizdi.

example: The blackboard still carries a dinosaur from yesterday's lesson.
translation: Bo‘r taxtada hali ham kechagi darsdan qolgan dinozavr bor.

example: A piece of chalk turned my black trousers into a cloudy sky.
translation: Bir bo‘lak bo‘r qora shimimni bulutli osmonga aylantirdi.

example: This marker makes every small mistake look important.
translation: Bu marker har bir kichik xatoni muhim qilib ko‘rsatadi.

example: My eraser works harder than my pencil during maths.
translation: Matematika darsida o‘chirg‘ichim qalamimdan ko‘proq ishlaydi.

example: Use a ruler unless you want another wavy rectangle.
translation: Yana to‘lqinsimon to‘rtburchak xohlamasangiz, chizg‘ich ishlating.

example: The sharpener made my pencil ready for its tiny writing career.
translation: Qalam ochgich qalamimni kichkina yozuvchilik faoliyatiga tayyorladi.

example: Even the calculator seemed surprised by my answer.
translation: Hatto kalkulyator ham javobimdan hayron qolgandek edi.

example: The projector made a small spelling mistake two metres wide.
translation: Proyektor kichkina imlo xatosini ikki metr kenglikda ko‘rsatdi.

example: With a clipboard in her hand, even my little sister looks official.
translation: Qo‘lida qisqichli taxtacha bo‘lsa, hatto singlim ham rasmiy xodimga o‘xshaydi.

example: My folder contains neat notes and one ancient sandwich wrapper.
translation: Hujjatlar jildimda tartibli qaydlar va bitta qadimiy sendvich o‘rami bor.

example: This binder keeps my papers together better than I keep my thoughts together.
translation: Bu halqali jild qog‘ozlarimni men fikrlarimni jamlaganimdan yaxshiroq jamlaydi.

example: I used the highlighter so much that the whole page glowed.
translation: Matn ajratish markerini shunchalik ko‘p ishlatdimki, butun sahifa yorishib ketdi.

example: This flashcard has a picture so funny that I never forget the word.
translation: Bu o‘quv kartochkasidagi rasm shunchalik kulgiliki, so‘zni hech qachon unutmayman.

example: The protractor proved that my perfect corner was not perfect.
translation: Transportir mukammal burchagim mukammal emasligini isbotladi.

example: She spun the globe and chose our imaginary holiday destination.
translation: U globusni aylantirib, xayoliy ta’til manzilimizni tanladi.

example: Grandpa's atlas knows countries that my new one does not.
translation: Bobomning atlasi yangi atlasim bilmaydigan mamlakatlarni biladi.

example: The missing page contained the answer, of course.
translation: Albatta, javob aynan yo‘qolgan sahifada edi.

example: This chapter is short enough to read before my tea gets cold.
translation: Bu bob choyim soviguncha o‘qib tugatadigan darajada qisqa.

example: Your paragraph needs a full stop before we all run out of breath.
translation: Hammamizning nafasimiz tugamasidan xatboshingizga nuqta kerak.

example: I used a bus ticket as a bookmark and nearly read past my stop.
translation: Avtobus chiptasini xatcho‘p qilib ishlatdim va o‘qib bekatimdan o‘tib ketay dedim.

example: I revise with the fridge closed to avoid long snack breaks.
translation: Uzoq tamaddilardan qochish uchun muzlatkichni yopib qo‘yib takrorlayman.

example: Let's review the notes before our memories go on holiday.
translation: Xotiramiz ta’tilga chiqishidan oldin qaydlarni qayta ko‘rib chiqaylik.

example: She can memorise a poem faster than I can find my glasses.
translation: U men ko‘zoynagimni topgunimcha she’rni yodlay oladi.

example: It is hard to concentrate when the clock sounds like a woodpecker.
translation: Soat qizilishton kabi taqillasa, diqqatni jamlash qiyin.

example: Focus on the instructions, not the squirrel outside.
translation: Tashqaridagi olmaxonga emas, ko‘rsatmalarga diqqat qarating.

example: Can you explain gravity without dropping my lunch?
translation: Tushligimni tushirib yubormasdan tortishish kuchini tushuntira olasizmi?

example: Describe your ideal classroom without including a swimming pool.
translation: Suzish havzasini qo‘shmasdan ideal sinfxonangizni tasvirlang.

example: We compare two essays, and both begin with a talking carrot.
translation: Ikki inshoni taqqoslaymiz, ikkalasi ham gapiradigan sabzi bilan boshlanadi.

example: Summarise the chapter without making your summary longer than the book.
translation: Qisqacha mazmunni kitobdan uzunroq qilmasdan bobni bayon qiling.

example: Underline the main point before your pencil wanders off.
translation: Qalamingiz boshqa yoqqa ketib qolmasidan asosiy fikrning tagiga chizing.

example: Highlight only the key words, or we will need sunglasses.
translation: Faqat asosiy so‘zlarni rang bilan ajrating, aks holda quyosh ko‘zoynagi kerak bo‘ladi.

example: Copy the address carefully unless you want your letter to travel alone.
translation: Xatingiz yolg‘iz sayohat qilishini xohlamasangiz, manzilni diqqat bilan ko‘chiring.

example: Please correct my spelling before I invite everyone to a desert instead of dessert.
translation: Hammani shirinlik o‘rniga sahroga taklif qilishimdan oldin imlomni tuzating.

example: Complete the final exercise and your pencil can rest.
translation: Oxirgi mashqni tugating, keyin qalamingiz dam olishi mumkin.

example: We managed to solve the problem before the bell rescued us.
translation: Qo‘ng‘iroq bizni qutqarishidan oldin masalani yechishga ulgurdik.

example: Calculate the total before promising everyone free ice cream.
translation: Hammaga bepul muzqaymoq va’da qilishdan oldin jami miqdorni hisoblang.

example: I had to guess the answer because my notes were in my other bag.
translation: Qaydlarim boshqa sumkamda bo‘lgani uchun javobni taxmin qilishimga to‘g‘ri keldi.

example: We will discuss the story after deciding who ate the last biscuit.
translation: Oxirgi pechenyeni kim yeganini aniqlagach, hikoyani muhokama qilamiz.

example: For homework, we research local history rather than local pizza prices.
translation: Uy vazifasi uchun mahalliy pitsa narxlarini emas, mahalliy tarixni o‘rganamiz.

example: I prepare my bag at night so mornings involve less detective work.
translation: Ertalab kamroq qidiruv bilan shug‘ullanish uchun sumkamni kechasi tayyorlayman.

example: Organise your notes before they form their own paper mountain.
translation: Qaydlaringiz alohida qog‘oz tog‘iga aylanmasidan ularni tartibga soling.

example: You can join our study group if you promise not to eat the examples.
translation: Misollarni yeb qo‘ymaslikka va’da bersangiz, o‘quv guruhimizga qo‘shilishingiz mumkin.

example: He plans to attend every lecture, including the one about planning.
translation: U har bir ma’ruzaga, jumladan, rejalashtirish haqidagisiga ham qatnashmoqchi.

example: Hand in your essay before the deadline grows teeth.
translation: Muddat tish chiqarishidan oldin inshongizni topshiring.

example: After missing a week, I needed two evenings to catch up.
translation: Bir hafta dars qoldirgach, yetishib olishim uchun ikki oqshom kerak bo‘ldi.

example: The exam began just as my lucky pen ran out of ink.
translation: Omadli ruchkamning siyohi tugashi bilan imtihon boshlandi.

example: Our spelling test included a word nobody could pronounce.
translation: Imlo sinovimizda hech kim talaffuz qila olmaydigan so‘z bor edi.

example: Dad lost the history quiz to someone who still needs help tying shoes.
translation: Dadam tarix savol-javobida hali oyoq kiyimini bog‘lashga yordam kerak bo‘lgan bolaga yutqazdi.

example: I got one extra mark for remembering my own name.
translation: O‘z ismimni eslaganim uchun bitta qo‘shimcha ball oldim.

example: Her grade went from C to A after she moved away from the window.
translation: U derazadan uzoqroqqa o‘tgach, bahosi C dan A ga ko‘tarildi.

example: My coursework includes three reports and a model that barely stands up.
translation: Kurs ishlarim uchta hisobot va zo‘rg‘a tik turadigan maketdan iborat.

example: The result surprised everyone, especially the student who had guessed.
translation: Natija hammani, ayniqsa taxmin qilgan o‘quvchini hayron qoldirdi.

example: If I pass this exam, my notes are getting a retirement party.
translation: Bu imtihondan o‘tsam, qaydlarim uchun nafaqaga chiqish bazmini qilaman.

example: You will not fail just because your handwriting looks like spaghetti.
translation: Faqat yozuvingiz spagettiga o‘xshagani uchun imtihondan yiqilmaysiz.

example: My first mistake was writing Tuesday on a Friday.
translation: Birinchi xatom juma kuni seshanba deb yozish bo‘ldi.

example: A small error turned fifty students into five hundred on the report.
translation: Kichik xatolik hisobotdagi ellik o‘quvchini besh yuztaga aylantirdi.

example: The teacher's feedback was kind, even about my square horse.
translation: O‘qituvchining fikrlari, hatto to‘rtburchak otim haqida ham, muloyim edi.

example: That correction changed the meaning from hungry to angry.
translation: O‘sha tuzatish ma’noni ochdan jahldorga o‘zgartirdi.

example: My progress is slow, but at least my dictionary gets regular exercise.
translation: O‘sishim sekin, lekin hech bo‘lmasa lug‘atim muntazam mashq qiladi.

example: She framed her certificate before unpacking her course books.
translation: U kurs kitoblarini sumkadan olishdan oldin sertifikatini ramkaga soldi.

example: His diploma hangs above the desk where he once cried over homework.
translation: Uning diplomi bir paytlar uy vazifasi ustida yig‘lagan stoli tepasida osilib turibdi.

example: She has a degree in chemistry and a very serious biscuit recipe.
translation: Uning kimyo bo‘yicha oliy ma’lumoti va juda jiddiy pechenye retsepti bor.

example: This qualification proves I can repair more than my own mistakes.
translation: Bu malaka faqat o‘z xatolarimdan boshqa narsalarni ham tuzata olishimni tasdiqlaydi.

example: My essay about silence was surprisingly long.
translation: Sukunat haqidagi inshom hayratlanarli darajada uzun bo‘ldi.

example: The assignment was to study advertising, not to buy everything.
translation: Topshiriq reklamani o‘rganish edi, hamma narsani sotib olish emas.

example: Our first task was finding a table under all the paper.
translation: Birinchi vazifamiz barcha qog‘ozlar ostidan stolni topish edi.

example: This grammar exercise gives my brain more exercise than my legs get.
translation: Bu grammatika mashqi miyamni oyoqlarimdan ham ko‘proq mashq qildiradi.

example: The deadline is Friday, which suddenly feels very close.
translation: Oxirgi muddat juma, u esa birdan juda yaqin tuyulmoqda.

example: I will retake the test with more revision and fewer lucky socks.
translation: Sinovni ko‘proq takrorlash va kamroq omadli paypoqlar bilan qayta topshiraman.

example: The oral exam went well until my stomach answered a question.
translation: Og‘zaki imtihon qornim bir savolga javob berguncha yaxshi o‘tdi.

example: My food vocabulary grows faster than my cooking skills.
translation: Taomlarga oid so‘z boyligim oshpazlik ko‘nikmalarimdan tezroq o‘sadi.

example: Grammar helps us explain who ate whose sandwich.
translation: Grammatika kim kimning sendvichini yeganini tushuntirishga yordam beradi.

example: I practise pronunciation with my dog, a very patient listener.
translation: Talaffuzni juda sabrli tinglovchi bo‘lgan itim bilan mashq qilaman.

example: My spelling improves when I stop trusting my sleepy fingers.
translation: Uyqusiragan barmoqlarimga ishonishni to‘xtatsam, imlom yaxshilanadi.

example: The alphabet song lives in my head without paying rent.
translation: Alifbo qo‘shig‘i boshimda ijara to‘lamay yashaydi.

example: Changing one vowel turned my pet into a pot.
translation: Bitta unlini o‘zgartirish uy hayvonimni qozonga aylantirdi.

example: That final consonant keeps escaping when I speak quickly.
translation: Tez gapirsam, oxirgi undosh doim qochib ketadi.

example: We clap for each syllable, so the lesson sounds like a tiny concert.
translation: Har bir bo‘g‘inda qarsak chalamiz, shuning uchun dars kichik konsertga o‘xshaydi.

example: A noun can name a person, a place, or your missing sandwich.
translation: Ot shaxsni, joyni yoki yo‘qolgan sendvichingizni bildirishi mumkin.

example: The verb sleep is easy to remember on Monday morning.
translation: Uxlash fe’lini dushanba ertalab eslab qolish oson.

example: She added the adjective enormous to describe my tiny lunch.
translation: U mening kichkina tushligimni tasvirlash uchun ulkan sifatini qo‘shdi.

example: The adverb quietly does not describe our study group.
translation: Jim ravishi bizning o‘quv guruhimizni tasvirlamaydi.

example: Without a pronoun, I would repeat my brother's name twenty times.
translation: Olmoshsiz akamning ismini yigirma marta takrorlagan bo‘lardim.

example: The wrong preposition put the cat inside the table.

example: The report explains why our busiest hour is just before lunch.
translation: Hisobot eng band soatimiz nega tushlik oldidan bo‘lishini tushuntiradi.

example: My first draft contains useful ideas and several unfinished complaints.
translation: Birinchi qoralamamda foydali g‘oyalar va bir nechta tugallanmagan shikoyat bor.

example: This version of the timetable finally includes a lunch break.
translation: Jadvalning bu nusxasida nihoyat tushlik tanaffusi bor.

example: Her presentation had six slides and no chance for us to get sleepy.
translation: Uning taqdimotida oltita slayd bor edi, bizda esa uyqusirashga imkon bo‘lmadi.

example: The summary should be shorter than the report, despite my colleague's efforts.
translation: Hamkasbimning urinishlariga qaramay, qisqacha mazmun hisobotdan qisqaroq bo‘lishi kerak.

example: Technology lets me attend a meeting without finding matching socks.
translation: Texnologiya menga bir xil paypoqlarni topmasdan yig‘ilishda qatnashish imkonini beradi.

example: This device counts my steps, including trips to the biscuit tin.
translation: Bu qurilma qadamlarimni, jumladan, pechenye qutisigacha borganlarimni ham sanaydi.

example: Grandma uses her tablet for recipes and surprisingly competitive chess.
translation: Buvim planshetini retseptlar va hayratlanarli darajada shiddatli shaxmat uchun ishlatadi.

example: My smartphone knows the weather but cannot find itself under the sofa.
translation: Smartfonim ob-havoni biladi, lekin divan tagida o‘zini topa olmaydi.

example: A larger monitor makes my spreadsheet look more important.
translation: Kattaroq monitor elektron jadvalimni muhimroq qilib ko‘rsatadi.

example: The printer waits until I am late before asking for paper.
translation: Printer qog‘oz so‘rashdan oldin kech qolishimni kutadi.

example: The scanner captured my drawing and a corner of my sleeve.
translation: Skaner rasmimni va yengimning bir chetini nusxaladi.

example: The tiny speaker makes our office sound like a concert hall.
translation: Kichkina karnay ofisimizni konsert zalidek jaranglatadi.

example: Move the microphone away from your lunch before the whole team hears it.
translation: Butun jamoa eshitmasidan mikrofonni tushligingizdan uzoqlashtiring.

example: My headphones help me study while my brother learns the trumpet.
translation: Ukam karnay chalishni o‘rganayotganda quloqchinim dars qilishimga yordam beradi.

example: With this headset, I look ready to land a plane rather than answer calls.
translation: Bu mikrofonli quloqchin bilan qo‘ng‘iroqqa javob berishga emas, samolyotni qo‘ndirishga tayyordek ko‘rinaman.

example: The webcam revealed the laundry mountain behind my tidy desk.
translation: Veb-kamera ozoda stolim ortidagi kir tog‘ini ko‘rsatib qo‘ydi.

example: My smartwatch reminds me to stand up during meetings about productivity.
translation: Aqlli soatim unumdorlik haqidagi yig‘ilishlarda o‘rnimdan turishimni eslatadi.

example: Whoever brings a charger becomes the hero of the afternoon.
translation: Quvvatlagich olib kelgan odam tushdan keyinning qahramoniga aylanadi.

example: My battery reaches one per cent whenever I need directions.
translation: Yo‘l ko‘rsatma kerak bo‘lganida batareyam bir foizga tushadi.

example: This cable is long enough to trip over from another room.
translation: Bu kabel boshqa xonadan turib ham qoqilib ketadigan darajada uzun.

example: The technician replaced a wire thinner than a piece of spaghetti.
translation: Texnik spagettidan ham ingichka simni almashtirdi.

example: The keyboard connects by USB, once I find the right port behind the desk.
translation: Stol ortidan kerakli portni topsam, klaviatura USB orqali ulanadi.

example: The faster processor finishes calculations before I finish reading the question.
translation: Tezroq protsessor savolni o‘qib bo‘lgunimcha hisob-kitoblarni tugatadi.

example: The sensor turns on the lights whenever our office cat walks past.
translation: Ofis mushugimiz yonidan o‘tganda datchik chiroqlarni yoqadi.

example: The joystick helped us steer the little robot away from everyone's shoes.
translation: Joystik kichkina robotni hammaning oyoq kiyimidan chetga yo‘naltirishga yordam berdi.

example: The modem stopped working just as my online class became interesting.
translation: Onlayn darsim qiziq bo‘la boshlaganda modem ishlamay qoldi.

example: The touchscreen works better when my fingers are not covered in biscuit crumbs.
translation: Barmoqlarim pechenye ushoqlariga belanmaganida sensorli ekran yaxshiroq ishlaydi.

example: We upgraded the hardware, but my typing speed stayed proudly slow.
translation: Kompyuter qismlarini yangiladik, ammo yozish tezligim mag‘rurona sekinligicha qoldi.

example: The computer needs more memory to hold all my unfinished projects.
translation: Tugallanmagan barcha loyihalarimni saqlash uchun kompyuterga ko‘proq xotira kerak.

example: The new software checks spelling but cannot improve my jokes.
translation: Yangi dastur imloni tekshiradi, lekin hazillarimni yaxshilay olmaydi.

example: This program turns numbers into charts and confusion into slightly prettier confusion.
translation: Bu dastur raqamlarni diagrammaga, chalkashlikni esa biroz chiroyliroq chalkashlikka aylantiradi.

example: I downloaded an app to remind me which apps I should delete.
translation: Qaysi ilovalarni o‘chirish kerakligini eslatish uchun ilova yuklab oldim.

example: Give the file a clear name before it joins the other twelve mysteries.
translation: Qolgan o‘n ikkita sirga qo‘shilmasidan faylga aniq nom bering.

example: The bin icon looks small, but it can swallow a whole report.
translation: Savat belgisi kichik ko‘rinadi, lekin butun hisobotni yutishi mumkin.

example: I opened the menu looking for settings, not soup.
translation: Menyuni sho‘rva emas, sozlamalarni qidirib ochdim.

example: The toolbar has a button for everything except making my deadline later.
translation: Asboblar panelida muddatimni kechiktirishdan boshqa hamma ish uchun tugma bor.

example: My cursor disappeared just when I wanted to look professional.
translation: Aynan professional ko‘rinmoqchi bo‘lganimda kursorim yo‘qolib qoldi.

example: My desktop is tidy because every file is hiding in one folder.
translation: Kompyuter ish stolim tartibli, chunki barcha fayllar bitta papkada yashiringan.

example: Our spreadsheet tracks office expenses, including emergency chocolate.
translation: Elektron jadvalimiz ofis xarajatlarini, jumladan, favqulodda shokolad xaridlarini ham hisobga oladi.

example: The database contains every customer except the one I need right now.
translation: Ma’lumotlar bazasida ayni damda kerak bo‘lganidan tashqari barcha mijozlar bor.

example: One missing bracket in the code ruined my peaceful afternoon.
translation: Koddagi bitta yetishmayotgan qavs tinch tushdan keyinimni buzdi.

example: I changed one setting and the computer began speaking Italian.
translation: Bitta sozlamani o‘zgartirdim va kompyuter italyancha gapira boshladi.

example: Update the app before blaming it for last year's problems.
translation: O‘tgan yilgi muammolarda ayblashdan oldin ilovani yangilang.

example: We can install the software while the kettle performs its own important task.
translation: Choynak o‘zining muhim vazifasini bajarayotganda dasturni o‘rnatishimiz mumkin.

example: I will uninstall the game before my lunch breaks become suspiciously long.
translation: Tushlik tanaffuslarim shubhali darajada cho‘zilmasidan o‘yinni o‘chirib tashlayman.

example: Delete the empty file, not the report we spent all week writing.
translation: Bir hafta yozgan hisobotimizni emas, bo‘sh faylni o‘chiring.

example: Please edit the title before our manager becomes a mango again.
translation: Menejerimiz yana mangoga aylanmasidan sarlavhani tahrir qiling.

example: Paste the address into the box, not into the public chat.
translation: Manzilni umumiy chatga emas, maydonga joylang.

example: Click undo before that accidental purple background becomes our official design.
translation: Tasodifiy binafsha fon rasmiy dizaynimizga aylanmasidan bekor qilishni bosing.

example: Print one copy first unless you want fifty identical mistakes.
translation: Ellikta bir xil xato xohlamasangiz, avval bitta nusxani chop eting.

example: Scan the receipt before the ink fades into a financial mystery.
translation: Siyoh o‘chib, moliyaviy sirga aylanmasidan chekni skaner qiling.

example: I type faster when nobody is watching my fingers.
translation: Hech kim barmoqlarimga qaramaganda tezroq yozaman.

example: Click once; the computer is thinking, not ignoring you.
translation: Bir marta bosing; kompyuter sizni mensimayotgani yo‘q, o‘ylayapti.

example: Drag the picture into place before it covers the boss's face.
translation: Boshliqning yuzini yopib qolmasidan rasmni joyiga suring.

example: Our class is online today, so my slippers can attend too.
translation: Bugun darsimiz onlayn, shuning uchun shippagim ham qatnashishi mumkin.

example: The app works offline, which makes train tunnels less annoying.
translation: Ilova internetsiz ishlaydi, bu poyezd tunnellarini kamroq zerikarli qiladi.

example: My browser has so many tabs that each title is now one letter.
translation: Brauzerimda shunchalik ko‘p varaq ochilganki, har bir sarlavha endi bitta harfdan iborat.

example: A search engine cannot find my glasses, although I keep asking.
translation: Qidiruv tizimi ko‘zoynagimni topa olmaydi, garchi qayta-qayta so‘rasam ham.

example: The link took us to a recipe instead of the meeting.
translation: Havola bizni yig‘ilishga emas, retseptga olib bordi.

example: Our homepage now explains what we sell before showing a giant smiling duck.
translation: Bosh sahifamiz endi ulkan jilmaygan o‘rdakni ko‘rsatishdan oldin nima sotishimizni tushuntiradi.

example: This webpage loads slowly enough for me to make tea.
translation: Bu veb-sahifa choy damlashga ulguradigan darajada sekin yuklanadi.

example: Somewhere in a tab, a video is playing music I cannot stop.
translation: Qaysidir brauzer varag‘ida men to‘xtata olmayotgan musiqa videosi o‘ynayapti.

example: Check the website address before trusting its offer of free laptops.
translation: Bepul noutbuklar taklifiga ishonishdan oldin sayt manzilini tekshiring.

example: Download the lesson before the village Wi-Fi takes its afternoon nap.
translation: Qishloqning Wi-Fi tarmog‘i tushdan keyin mizg‘ishga ketmasidan darsni yuklab oling.

example: Upload the final photo, preferably the one where my eyes are open.
translation: Yakuniy suratni, yaxshisi ko‘zlarim ochiq tushganini yuklang.

example: I subscribe to a science newsletter that makes breakfast more interesting.
translation: Nonushtani qiziqroq qiladigan ilmiy xabarnomaga obuna bo‘lganman.

example: I browse the library website when I should be returning its books.
translation: Kutubxona kitoblarini qaytarishim kerak bo‘lgan paytda uning saytini ko‘rib o‘tiraman.

example: Search for the exact phrase unless you want results about dancing onions.
translation: Raqsga tushadigan piyozlar haqida natijalar xohlamasangiz, aniq iborani qidiring.

example: Connect to the school network before declaring the internet broken.
translation: Internet buzilganini e’lon qilishdan oldin maktab tarmog‘iga ulaning.

example: My connection froze with my mouth open during the introduction.
translation: Tanishtirish paytida ulanishim og‘zim ochiq holatda qotib qoldi.

example: The office network is busiest when everyone sends Friday reports.
translation: Hamma juma hisobotlarini yuborganda ofis tarmog‘i eng band bo‘ladi.

example: The Wi-Fi password is longer than our office welcome speech.
translation: Wi-Fi paroli ofisimizdagi qutlov nutqidan uzunroq.

example: The router blinked calmly while we blamed it for everything.
translation: Biz hamma narsada ayblayotganimizda router xotirjam miltillab turdi.

example: The signal is strongest beside the window and weakest beside my patience.
translation: Signal deraza yonida eng kuchli, sabrim yonida esa eng kuchsiz.

example: Faster broadband means my video calls now show every embarrassing detail.
translation: Tezroq internet videoqo‘ng‘iroqlarim endi har bir noqulay tafsilotni ko‘rsatishini anglatadi.

example: Her blog explains computer problems using pictures of confused penguins.
translation: Uning blogi kompyuter muammolarini gangigan pingvinlar rasmlari bilan tushuntiradi.

example: Someone on the forum solved the problem I had blamed on Monday.
translation: Forumdagi kimdir men dushanbadan ko‘rgan muammoni hal qildi.

example: I listen to a language podcast while my laundry goes round.
translation: Kirlarim aylanayotganda til o‘rgatuvchi podkast tinglayman.

example: The webinar taught me useful skills while my cat slept through the whole thing.
translation: Mushugim boshidan oxirigacha uxlagan vebinar menga foydali ko‘nikmalar o‘rgatdi.

example: Clear communication prevents five people from bringing the same cake.
translation: Aniq axborot almashish besh kishining bir xil tort olib kelishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.

example: Our conversation about work became a serious debate about lunch.
translation: Ish haqidagi suhbatimiz tushlik bo‘yicha jiddiy bahsga aylandi.

example: The group chat contains three useful messages and forty pictures of cats.
translation: Guruh chatida uchta foydali xabar va qirqta mushuk rasmi bor.

example: Text me the room number so I do not join another wedding by mistake.
translation: Yana adashib boshqa to‘yga kirib qolmasligim uchun xona raqamini xabar qilib yuboring.

example: Please reply before I invent six possible explanations for your silence.
translation: Sukutingiz uchun oltita mumkin bo‘lgan izoh o‘ylab topishimdan oldin javob bering.

example: She responds to customer questions faster than I respond to my alarm.
translation: U mijoz savollariga men budilnigimga javob berganimdan tezroq javob qaytaradi.

example: Contact the help desk if your computer starts speaking in symbols.
translation: Kompyuteringiz belgilar tilida gapira boshlasa, yordam xizmatiga bog‘laning.

example: Dial the office number carefully; yesterday I called a pet shop.
translation: Ofis raqamini diqqat bilan tering; kecha men hayvonlar do‘koniga qo‘ng‘iroq qilibman.

example: Do not hang up yet; I have finally found the document under my lunch.
translation: Hali telefonni qo‘ymang; hujjatni nihoyat tushligim tagidan topdim.

example: I left a voicemail, then worried that I had forgotten my own name.
translation: Ovozli xabar qoldirdim, keyin o‘z ismimni aytishni unutdimmi deb xavotirlandim.

example: My inbox fills up faster than the office kettle.
translation: Kiruvchi xatlar qutim ofis choynagidan tezroq to‘ladi.

example: The attachment was missing from my email about checking attachments.
translation: Biriktirilgan fayllarni tekshirish haqidagi xatimda ilova yo‘q edi.

example: Forward the invitation to Ali before he plans a quiet evening.
translation: Ali tinch oqshom rejalashtirmasidan taklifnomani unga yuboring.

example: Did you receive my message, or is it still touring the internet?
translation: Xabarimni oldingizmi yoki u hali ham internet bo‘ylab sayohat qilyaptimi?

example: The service could not deliver my message because the address was imaginary.
translation: Manzil xayoliy bo‘lgani uchun xizmat xabarimni yetkaza olmadi.

example: A notification interrupted the app that was teaching me to concentrate.
translation: Diqqatni jamlashni o‘rgatayotgan ilovamni bildirishnoma bo‘lib qo‘ydi.

example: The calendar alert reminded me of a meeting I was already missing.
translation: Taqvim ogohlantirishi allaqachon o‘tkazib yuborayotgan yig‘ilishimni eslatdi.

example: Mute your microphone before your blender joins the discussion.
translation: Blenderingiz muhokamaga qo‘shilmasidan mikrofoningizni o‘chiring.

example: Remember to unmute before delivering another brilliant silent speech.
translation: Yana bir ajoyib ovozsiz nutq so‘zlashdan oldin mikrofonni yoqishni unutmang.

example: Turn the volume down unless the next village needs this lecture too.
translation: Bu ma’ruza keyingi qishloqqa ham kerak bo‘lmasa, ovozni pasaytiring.

example: The training video stars a stapler that never jams.
translation: O‘quv videosining bosh qahramoni hech qachon tiqilib qolmaydigan stepler.

example: The audio is clear enough to hear someone opening biscuits.
translation: Ovoz kimdir pechenye ochayotganini eshitadigan darajada aniq.

example: They broadcast the school concert, including our surprise microphone squeak.
translation: Ular maktab konsertini, jumladan, mikrofonimizning kutilmagan chiyillashini ham efirga uzatishdi.

example: Please announce the winner before my knees stop shaking.
translation: Tizzalarim titrashdan to‘xtamasidan g‘olibni e’lon qiling.

example: Mention the deadline early, not after everyone has put their coats on.
translation: Muddatni hamma paltosini kiyganidan keyin emas, oldinroq ayting.

example: My account has a serious username and a picture of a dancing lemon.
translation: Hisobimning foydalanuvchi nomi jiddiy, rasmi esa raqsga tushayotgan limon.

example: Choose a username you will not hate explaining at a job interview.
translation: Ishga kirish suhbatida tushuntirish noqulay bo‘lmaydigan foydalanuvchi nomini tanlang.

example: Max looks offended that his name is not a strong password.
translation: Maks o‘z ismi kuchli parol emasligidan xafa ko‘rinadi.

example: Her profile photo looks professional, unlike the twelve attempts before it.
translation: Profil surati undan oldingi o‘n ikki urinishdan farqli ravishda professional ko‘rinadi.

example: Check your privacy settings before the whole internet meets your bedroom.
translation: Butun internet yotoqxonangiz bilan tanishmasidan maxfiylik sozlamalarini tekshiring.

example: Keep the class group private unless you want strangers checking your homework.
translation: Begonalar uy vazifangizni tekshirishini xohlamasangiz, sinf guruhini yopiq saqlang.

example: That post is public, so even your old headteacher could read it.
translation: O‘sha post hammaga ochiq, shuning uchun hatto sobiq direktoringiz ham uni o‘qishi mumkin.

example: A secure account needs more protection than your pet's birthday.
translation: Himoyalangan hisob uchun uy hayvoningizning tug‘ilgan kunidan ko‘proq himoya kerak.

example: Verify the sender's identity before helping a mysterious prince with his banking.
translation: Sirli shahzodaga bank ishlarida yordam berishdan oldin jo‘natuvchining kimligini tekshiring.

example: Protect your files before your laptop decides to have an adventure.
translation: Noutbukingiz sarguzashtga otlanishga qaror qilmasidan fayllaringizni himoya qiling.

example: The torch app asked for permission to read my contacts, which seemed rather curious.
translation: Chiroq ilovasi kontaktlarimni o‘qishga ruxsat so‘radi, bu ancha qiziq tuyuldi.

example: Only the project team has access to our unfinished designs.
translation: Tugallanmagan dizaynlarimizdan faqat loyiha jamoasi foydalana oladi.

example: A backup saved my report when the laptop met a cup of tea.
translation: Noutbuk bir piyola choy bilan uchrashganda zaxira nusxa hisobotimni saqlab qoldi.

example: A computer virus does not need a scarf or hot soup.
translation: Kompyuter virusiga sharf ham, issiq sho‘rva ham kerak emas.

example: My spam folder thinks I have won more prizes than any athlete.
translation: Spam papkam meni har qanday sportchidan ko‘proq sovrin yutgan deb o‘ylaydi.

example: The free-laptop offer was a scam with very enthusiastic punctuation.
translation: Bepul noutbuk taklifi juda jo‘shqin tinish belgilariga ega firibgarlik edi.

example: A hacker would find my cat's name easier to guess than I once thought.
translation: Xaker uchun mushugimning ismini topish men ilgari o‘ylaganimdan osonroq bo‘lardi.

example: Block the sender who keeps offering you a castle for ten pounds.
translation: Sizga o‘n funtga qasr taklif qilaveradigan jo‘natuvchini bloklang.

example: The email filter sent the fake prince straight to spam.
translation: Xat filtri soxta shahzodani to‘g‘ri spamga jo‘natdi.

example: You can sign up for the course without telling the website your dog's life story.
translation: Saytga itingizning hayotini hikoya qilmasdan kursga ro‘yxatdan o‘tishingiz mumkin.

example: I could not unlock my phone while wearing those enormous gloves.
translation: O‘sha ulkan qo‘lqoplarni kiyib telefonimni qulfdan chiqara olmadim.

example: Reset your password if remembering it requires an archaeological expedition.
translation: Parolingizni eslash uchun arxeologik ekspeditsiya kerak bo‘lsa, uni yangidan belgilang.

example: We managed to recover the file that I had confidently deleted.
translation: Men ishonch bilan o‘chirgan faylni tiklashga muvaffaq bo‘ldik.

example: Log in before writing your essay, or the website may forget you exist.
translation: Insho yozishdan oldin hisobga kiring, aks holda sayt borligingizni unutishi mumkin.

example: Log out on shared computers before the next person becomes you.
translation: Umumiy kompyuterda keyingi odam sizga aylanmasidan hisobdan chiqing.

example: Explaining a problem calmly is a skill I practise near the printer.
translation: Muammoni xotirjam tushuntirish printer yonida mashq qiladigan ko‘nikmamdir.

example: Her ability to remember names makes every school reunion easier.
translation: Uning ismlarni eslab qolish qobiliyati har bir sinfdoshlar uchrashuvini osonlashtiradi.

example: He has a talent for turning dull numbers into interesting stories.
translation: U zerikarli raqamlarni qiziqarli hikoyalarga aylantirish iste’dodiga ega.

example: The broken projector tested our creativity and our drawing skills.
translation: Buzilgan proyektor ijodkorligimizni va rasm chizish ko‘nikmalarimizni sinadi.

example: My confidence grew after the audience laughed at the right moment.
translation: Tinglovchilar kerakli paytda kulgach, o‘zimga ishonchim oshdi.

example: Learning to code requires patience, especially with missing commas.
translation: Kod yozishni o‘rganish, ayniqsa tushib qolgan vergullar bilan, sabr talab qiladi.

example: My concentration survived the traffic but not the smell of fresh bread.
translation: Diqqatim transport shovqiniga bardosh berdi, lekin yangi non hidiga emas.

example: A little effort every day works better than one heroic night before the exam.
translation: Har kuni ozgina harakat qilish imtihon oldidagi bitta qahramonona kechadan yaxshiroq natija beradi.

example: There is a clear improvement: my emails now reach the right people.
translation: Aniq yaxshilanish bor: xatlarim endi kerakli odamlarga yetib boryapti.

example: Finishing the course was an achievement worth more than a sleepy thumbs-up.
translation: Kursni tugatish uyqusirab bosh barmoq ko‘rsatishdan ko‘proq e’tirofga loyiq yutuq edi.

example: The workshop was a success because everyone left with a working website.
translation: Amaliy seminar muvaffaqiyatli o‘tdi, chunki hamma ishlaydigan sayt bilan ketdi.

example: Her main strength is explaining complex ideas without making anyone feel silly.
translation: Uning asosiy kuchli jihati murakkab g‘oyalarni hech kimni nodon his qildirmay tushuntirishidir.

example: My weakness is public speaking, especially when the microphone whistles back.
translation: Zaif jihatim omma oldida gapirish, ayniqsa mikrofon javoban hushtak chalganda.

example: You are capable of leading the session without hiding behind the slides.
translation: Slaydlar ortiga yashirinmasdan mashg‘ulotni boshqarishga qodirsiz.

example: A skilled technician can hear trouble before the machine starts dancing.
translation: Malakali texnik uskuna raqsga tushishidan oldin nosozlikni ovozidan sezadi.

example: The course teaches practical skills, such as fixing a tap without flooding the room.
translation: Kurs xonani suvga bostirmay kranni tuzatish kabi amaliy ko‘nikmalarni o‘rgatadi.

example: Our creative designer turned a boring instruction sheet into a comic.
translation: Ijodkor dizaynerimiz zerikarli ko‘rsatmalar varag‘ini komiksga aylantirdi.

example: I felt confident until someone asked me to connect the projector.
translation: Kimdir proyektorni ulashimni so‘raguncha o‘zimga ishongan edim.

example: Independent learners still ask questions; they just find the answers more actively.
translation: Mustaqil o‘rganuvchilar ham savol beradi; ular shunchaki javoblarni faolroq izlaydi.

example: A flexible team can change the plan without treating it as a national disaster.
translation: Moslashuvchan jamoa rejani milliy falokat deb bilmasdan o‘zgartira oladi.

example: Accurate notes stopped us from ordering a thousand folders instead of a hundred.
translation: Aniq qaydlar yuzta o‘rniga mingta jild buyurtma qilishimizga yo‘l qo‘ymadi.

example: A careful reader noticed that the meeting date was last Tuesday.
translation: Sinchkov o‘quvchi yig‘ilish sanasi o‘tgan seshanba ekanini payqadi.

example: You can develop your speaking skills without giving speeches to the whole bus.
translation: Butun avtobusga nutq so‘zlamasdan ham gapirish ko‘nikmalaringizni rivojlantira olasiz.

example: I want to improve my typing so the keyboard stops winning our daily race.
translation: Klaviatura kundalik poygamizda yutishni to‘xtatishi uchun yozishimni yaxshilamoqchiman.

example: We had to adapt when the training room became a temporary storeroom.
translation: O‘quv xonasi vaqtinchalik omborga aylanganda moslashishga majbur bo‘ldik.

example: Our experiment tested whether music helps plants or just entertains the gardener.
translation: Tajribamiz musiqa o‘simliklarga yordam beradimi yoki faqat bog‘bonni ovutadimi, shuni tekshirdi.

example: The survey found that nobody wanted meetings before breakfast.
translation: So‘rov hech kim nonushtadan oldin yig‘ilish xohlamasligini aniqladi.

example: The questionnaire about free time took most of my free time.
translation: Bo‘sh vaqt haqidagi anketa bo‘sh vaqtimning ko‘p qismini oldi.

example: We took a sample of pond water and found a very busy tiny world.
