translation: Dramatik momaqaldiroqni chetga qo‘yib, sabablarni aniq bayon qiling.

example: Let us get down to the evidence before the introduction becomes a family history.
translation: Kirish oilaviy tarixga aylanmasidan dalillarga jiddiy kirishaylik.

example: Flesh out the idea with evidence, not another decorative paragraph.
translation: G‘oyani yana bir bezak xatboshi bilan emas, dalillar bilan boyiting.

example: We can build on last year's results instead of rediscovering the same stapler.
translation: Xuddi o‘sha steplerni qayta kashf qilish o‘rniga o‘tgan yilgi natijalarni rivojlantira olamiz.

example: Draw on your experience, including the project that taught you to label everything.
translation: Tajribangizdan, jumladan, hamma narsaga yorliq qo‘yishni o‘rgatgan loyihadan foydalaning.

example: Can you account for the extra zero without blaming the cat?
translation: Mushukni ayblamasdan ortiqcha nolning sababini tushuntira olasizmi?

example: Allow for delays, especially when six people share one charger.
translation: Ayniqsa olti kishi bitta quvvatlagichdan foydalansa, kechikishlarni hisobga oling.

example: The argument may boil down to who gets the comfortable chair.
translation: Bahsning mohiyati qulay stul kimga tegishiga borib taqalishi mumkin.

example: The decision will come down to cost, not the charm of the brochure.
translation: Qaror buklet jozibasiga emas, xarajatga bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

example: That conclusion does not follow from finding one cheerful accountant.
translation: Bitta quvnoq hisobchini topishdan bunday xulosa kelib chiqmaydi.

example: Does this example tie in with the topic, or do you just like penguins?
translation: Bu misol mavzuga bog‘lanadimi yoki siz shunchaki pingvinlarni yoqtirasizmi?

example: The results bear out our prediction that shorter instructions cause fewer sighs.
translation: Natijalar qisqaroq ko‘rsatmalar kamroq xo‘rsinishga sabab bo‘lishi haqidagi taxminimizni tasdiqlaydi.

example: His explanation does not add up unless the printer can walk.
translation: Printer yura olmasa, uning izohi mantiqan to‘g‘ri chiqmaydi.

example: We tried to piece together the events from three emails and a coffee stain.
translation: Uchta xat va qahva dog‘idan voqealarni tiklashga urindik.

example: What are you trying to get at with this story about a nervous toaster?
translation: Asabiy toster haqidagi hikoya bilan aslida nimani demoqchisiz?

example: Put forward a solution before we form another committee to find one.
translation: Yechim izlash uchun yana qo‘mita tuzmasimizdan bir yechim taklif qiling.

example: We can go ahead once someone confirms that this is the right building.
translation: Kimdir bu to‘g‘ri bino ekanini tasdiqlagach, boshlashimiz mumkin.

example: Let's move on before the first question becomes a three-part documentary.
translation: Birinchi savol uch qismli hujjatli filmga aylanmasidan keyingisiga o‘taylik.

example: We decided to press on despite the printer's dramatic noises.
translation: Printerning dramatik shovqinlariga qaramay davom etishga qaror qildik.

example: The team will push ahead with the trial after replacing the sleepy sensor.
translation: Jamoa uyqusiragan datchikni almashtirgach, sinovni qat’iyat bilan davom ettiradi.

example: I should get on with the report instead of designing its imaginary award.
translation: Xayoliy mukofotini loyihalash o‘rniga hisobotni davom ettirishim kerak.

example: We need to step up our efforts, not merely the size of our motivational posters.
translation: Ruhlantiruvchi plakatlar hajmini emas, harakatlarimizni kuchaytirishimiz kerak.

example: I struggle to keep up with changes to a plan called the final plan.
translation: Yakuniy reja deb atalgan rejadagi o‘zgarishlarni kuzatishga zo‘rg‘a ulguraman.

example: We may fall behind if every small decision needs a grand ceremony.
translation: Har bir kichik qarorga katta marosim kerak bo‘lsa, ortda qolishimiz mumkin.

example: To get ahead, try learning the software rather than blaming the mouse.
translation: Ilgarilash uchun sichqonchani ayblash o‘rniga dasturni o‘rganishga harakat qiling.

example: I began to catch on when she replaced the equation with three apples.
translation: U tenglamani uchta olma bilan almashtirganda tushuna boshladim.

example: Do not take on another project until your desk becomes visible again.
translation: Stolingiz yana ko‘rinmaguncha boshqa loyihani zimmangizga olmang.

example: Carry out the test before celebrating your completely untested invention.
translation: Mutlaqo sinalmagan ixtirongizni nishonlashdan oldin sinovni o‘tkazing.

example: Follow up the discussion with action, preferably before everyone forgets it.
translation: Hamma unutmasidan muhokamani amaliy ish bilan davom ettiring.

example: An elegant plan helps only if we follow through.
translation: Nafis reja faqat uni oxiriga yetkazsak yordam beradi.

example: It was easy to see through his excuse once we found the empty cake box.
translation: Bo‘sh tort qutisini topgach, uning bahonasini anglash oson bo‘ldi.

example: Every proposal must go through review, even one with a charming penguin logo.
translation: Har bir taklif, hatto yoqimli pingvin logotipi bor bo‘lsa ham, ko‘rib chiqishdan o‘tishi kerak.

example: We can get through these forms before the kettle boils if nobody invents new questions.
translation: Hech kim yangi savol o‘ylamasa, choynak qaynaguncha shakllarni tugata olamiz.

example: We had to start over after discovering that the chart described the wrong year.
translation: Diagramma noto‘g‘ri yilni ko‘rsatganini bilib, boshidan boshlashga majbur bo‘ldik.

example: Many experts start out asking questions that sound wonderfully basic.
translation: Ko‘p mutaxassislar dastlab juda sodda tuyuladigan savollar berishdan boshlaydi.

example: We will set about solving the issue once the debate about its name ends.
translation: Masalaning nomi haqidagi bahs tugagach, uni hal qilishga kirishamiz.

example: Before we embark on another study, let us read the one we already finished.
translation: Yana bir tadqiqotga kirishishdan oldin tugatganimizni o‘qiylik.

example: We could end up with a simpler system if we resist adding twelve extra features.
translation: O‘n ikki qo‘shimcha imkoniyatni qo‘shishga berilmasak, oxirida soddaroq tizimga ega bo‘lishimiz mumkin.

example: The discussion began to wind down when even the loudest member checked the clock.
translation: Hatto eng baland ovozli a’zo soatga qaragach, muhokama asta-sekin tugay boshladi.

example: We will phase out paper forms before they occupy the whole building.
translation: Qog‘oz shakllar butun binoni egallamasidan ularni bosqichma-bosqich bekor qilamiz.

example: Phase in the new system so Monday does not become a national emergency.
translation: Dushanba milliy favqulodda holatga aylanmasligi uchun yangi tizimni bosqichma-bosqich kiriting.

example: We will opt for the simple design, despite the gold one's confident sparkle.
translation: Oltin nusxaning ishonchli yaltirashiga qaramay, oddiy dizaynni tanlaymiz.

example: Can we settle on a date before the calendar needs replacing?
translation: Taqvimni almashtirishga to‘g‘ri kelmasidan bir sanaga kelisha olamizmi?

example: We wanted a perfect solution but had to settle for one that worked.
translation: Mukammal yechim xohladik, ammo ishlaydiganiga rozi bo‘lishga to‘g‘ri keldi.

example: I would go for the clearer chart, even if it has fewer exciting arrows.
translation: Unda qiziqarli strelkalar kamroq bo‘lsa ham, aniqroq diagrammani tanlardim.

example: The panel may rule against the proposal to replace meetings with interpretive dance.
translation: Hay’at yig‘ilishlarni ifodali raqs bilan almashtirish taklifiga qarshi qaror chiqarishi mumkin.

example: Hold off announcing victory until the machine has actually switched on.
translation: Uskuna haqiqatan yoqilmaguncha g‘alaba e’lon qilishni kutib turing.

example: Do not hold back useful criticism just because the chart is my favourite colour.
translation: Diagramma sevimli rangimda bo‘lgani uchun foydali tanqidni aytishdan tiyilmang.

example: We should step back and ask whether anyone needs this complicated solution.
translation: Bir chetdan qarab, bu murakkab yechim kimgadir kerakmi deb so‘rashimiz kerak.

example: Let me sleep on the proposal rather than approve it before my nap.
translation: Mizg‘ishdan oldin tasdiqlagandan ko‘ra taklifni ertagacha o‘ylab ko‘ray.

example: The committee cannot sit on this request until the chairs become antiques.
translation: Qo‘mita bu so‘rovni stullar qadimiy buyumga aylanguncha cho‘zib yurolmaydi.

example: Stick to the question unless you want another accidental history lecture.
translation: Yana tasodifiy tarix ma’ruzasi xohlamasangiz, savoldan chetga chiqmang.

example: Commit to a realistic deadline, not one invented during a burst of enthusiasm.
translation: Ishtiyoq to‘lqinida o‘ylangan emas, haqiqiy muddatni zimmangizga oling.

example: He agreed to back down when the evidence arrived on a very large screen.
translation: Dalil juda katta ekranda paydo bo‘lgach, u fikridan qaytishga rozi bo‘ldi.

example: I will not give in just because your argument comes with free biscuits.
translation: Dalilingiz bepul pechenye bilan kelgani uchungina rozi bo‘lmayman.

meaning: yordam yoki javob uchun murojaat qilmoq
example: We can turn to the data when our opinions start chasing each other in circles.
translation: Fikrlarimiz bir-birini aylanib quva boshlaganda ma’lumotlarga murojaat qila olamiz.

example: We can fall back on paper notes if the computer chooses another holiday.
translation: Kompyuter yana ta’tilni tanlasa, qog‘oz qaydlarga qayta olamiz.

example: The report can do without five different photographs of the same button.
translation: Hisobot bir tugmaning besh xil suratisiz ham bo‘la oladi.

example: We can dispense with the long introduction and get straight to the mystery.
translation: Uzun kirishdan voz kechib, darhol sirga o‘tishimiz mumkin.

example: Do not pass up the chance to ask a question before the expert escapes.
translation: Mutaxassis qochib ketmasidan savol berish imkoniyatini qo‘ldan boy bermang.

example: I will take up your offer of help before this spreadsheet grows another page.
translation: Bu jadval yana bir sahifa o‘stirmasidan yordamingizni qabul qilaman.

example: Saying I was hungry would understate the problem: I ate the menu.
translation: Qornim ochligini aytish muammoni kamaytirib ko‘rsatgan bo‘lardi: men menyuni yeb qo‘ydim.

example: One partner may pull out if the plan still includes a dancing delivery robot.
translation: Rejada hali ham raqsga tushadigan yetkazuvchi robot bo‘lsa, bir hamkor chiqib ketishi mumkin.

example: Some volunteers drop out when the short study enters its sixth month.
translation: Qisqa tadqiqot oltinchi oyga kirganda ayrim ko‘ngillilar uni tark etadi.

example: The editor will sign off the report once we remove the imaginary sources.
translation: Xayoliy manbalarni olib tashlagach, muharrir hisobotni yakuniy tasdiqlaydi.

example: I can go along with the plan, provided the budget does not assume free electricity.
translation: Budjet bepul elektrni nazarda tutmasa, rejaga qo‘shila olaman.

example: Break down the problem before it becomes one enormous cloud of worry.
translation: Muammo ulkan xavotir bulutiga aylanishidan oldin uni qismlarga ajrating.

example: We had to break off the discussion when the alarm started competing with us.
translation: Signal biz bilan raqobatlasha boshlaganda muhokamani to‘xtatishga majbur bo‘ldik.

example: One simple example helped us break through the confusion.
translation: Bitta sodda misol chalkashlikni yengishimizga yordam berdi.

example: Trim down the report until its summary no longer needs a bookmark.
translation: Qisqacha mazmuniga xatcho‘p kerak bo‘lmay qolguncha hisobotni ixchamlashtiring.

example: Cut out the repeated sentences unless repetition is the actual topic.
translation: Mavzu takrorlash bo‘lmasa, takrorlangan gaplarni olib tashlang.

example: Please do not cut off the speaker just as the explanation starts making sense.
translation: Izoh tushunarli bo‘la boshlaganida so‘zlovchining gapini bo‘lmang.

example: Fill in the missing dates before history develops several mysterious gaps.
translation: Tarixda bir necha sirli bo‘shliq paydo bo‘lmasidan yetishmagan sanalarni to‘ldiring.

example: Fill out the form in plain language, not in the style of a royal announcement.
translation: Shaklni qirollik e’loni uslubida emas, oddiy tilda to‘ldiring.

example: Do not leave out the one fact that makes your confident conclusion doubtful.
translation: Ishonchli xulosangizni shubhali qiladigan yagona faktni tashlab ketmang.

example: Put aside your favourite explanation and look at the actual numbers.
translation: Sevimli izohingizni chetga surib, haqiqiy raqamlarga qarang.

example: Lay out your reasoning so readers do not need a detective licence.
translation: O‘quvchilarga detektiv litsenziyasi kerak bo‘lmasligi uchun mulohazangizni aniq bayon qiling.

example: Map out the stages before stage one becomes permanent.
translation: Birinchi bosqich abadiy bo‘lib qolmasidan bosqichlarni rejalashtiring.

example: Clear reasoning can mark out a good report more than a shiny cover can.
translation: Aniq mulohaza yaxshi hisobotni yaltiroq muqovadan ko‘ra yaxshiroq ajratib ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

example: Cross out the irrelevant example before the penguin takes over the essay.
translation: Pingvin inshoni egallab olmasidan aloqasiz misolning ustidan chizing.

example: Write down the idea before it joins your other brilliant forgotten thoughts.
translation: G‘oya boshqa unutilgan ajoyib fikrlaringizga qo‘shilmasidan uni yozib qo‘ying.

example: Note down the exact figure rather than something between five and fifty.
translation: Besh bilan ellik orasidagi nimadir emas, aniq raqamni qayd qiling.

example: Read through the conclusion before giving it the title Final Final Final.
translation: Xulosaga Yakuniy Yakuniy Yakuniy deb nom berishdan oldin uni o‘qib chiqing.

example: I need to read up on the topic before my confidence gets ahead of my knowledge.
translation: Ishonchim bilimimdan o‘zib ketmasidan mavzuni o‘qib o‘rganishim kerak.

example: Look up the term before using it to impress the one person who knows it.
translation: Atamani biladigan yagona odamni qoyil qoldirish uchun ishlatishdan oldin ma’nosini tekshiring.

example: We can look back on the mistake as a lesson, once the embarrassment fades.
translation: Xijolat yo‘qolgach, xatoni saboq sifatida eslashimiz mumkin.

example: Look ahead before choosing a system that cannot handle next month's work.
translation: Keyingi oy ishini ko‘tara olmaydigan tizimni tanlashdan oldin kelajakni hisobga oling.

example: Run through the main points before the audience runs out of patience.
translation: Tinglovchilar sabri tugamasidan asosiy fikrlarni qisqa ko‘rib chiqing.

example: Talk through the method slowly enough for my pencil to keep up.
translation: Qalamim ulguradigan darajada sekin qilib usulni bosqichma-bosqich tushuntiring.

example: We should talk over the options before naming the project after a planet.
translation: Loyihaga sayyora nomini berishdan oldin variantlarni muhokama qilishimiz kerak.

example: Could you walk through the example without skipping the bit everybody finds difficult?
translation: Hamma qiyin deb biladigan qismini o‘tkazmay misolni qadamma-qadam tushuntira olasizmi?

meaning: zarur ravishda talab qilmoq yoki keltirib chiqarmoq
example: The change will entail retraining, not merely buying brighter name badges.
translation: O‘zgarish shunchaki yorqinroq ism nishonlari emas, qayta o‘qitishni talab qiladi.

example: Clear labels enable people to work without becoming part-time detectives.
translation: Aniq yorliqlar odamlarga yarim stavkali detektivga aylanmay ishlash imkonini beradi.

example: A shared glossary can facilitate discussion and reduce theatrical misunderstandings.
translation: Umumiy lug‘at muhokamani osonlashtirib, dramatik tushunmovchiliklarni kamaytirishi mumkin.

example: A bold claim will require stronger evidence than your uncle's enthusiastic nod.
translation: Dadil da’voga amakining jo‘shqin bosh irg‘ashidan kuchliroq dalil kerak.

example: The results depend on accurate measurements, not on how serious we look.
translation: Natijalar qanchalik jiddiy ko‘rinishimizga emas, aniq o‘lchovlarga bog‘liq.

example: The two accounts differ mainly on who ate the evidence.
translation: Ikki bayon asosan dalilni kim yeganida farq qiladi.

example: Your explanation should not resemble a maze with no exit.
translation: Izohingiz chiqishsiz labirintga o‘xshamasligi kerak.

example: How does the dancing robot relate to the question about saving time?
translation: Raqsga tushadigan robot vaqt tejash haqidagi savolga qanday bog‘lanadi?

example: These figures concern real expenses, including our unexpectedly costly pencils.
translation: Bu raqamlar haqiqiy xarajatlarga, jumladan, kutilmaganda qimmatga tushgan qalamlarimizga tegishli.

example: I regard a working example as more useful than a spectacular promise.
translation: Ishlaydigan misolni ajoyib va’dadan foydaliroq deb hisoblayman.

example: Three guesses do not constitute evidence, even if they agree.
translation: Uchta taxmin bir-biriga mos kelsa ham, dalil hisoblanmaydi.

example: The labels must correspond to the samples, not to whichever name sounds nicest.
translation: Yorliqlar eng yoqimli eshitilgan nomga emas, namunalarga mos kelishi kerak.

example: We derive the estimate from records, not from a particularly cheerful mood.
translation: Hisobni juda quvnoq kayfiyatdan emas, qaydlardan chiqaramiz.

example: Obtain permission before transforming the corridor into a research laboratory.
translation: Yo‘lakni tadqiqot laboratoriyasiga aylantirishdan oldin ruxsat oling.

example: You acquire useful habits through practice, not by buying a more impressive notebook.
translation: Foydali odatlarni zo‘rroq daftar sotib olib emas, mashq orqali egallaysiz.

example: We can attain better accuracy without asking everyone to hold their breath.
translation: Hammadan nafasini ushlab turishni so‘ramay ham yuqoriroq aniqlikka erisha olamiz.

example: We could accomplish more if we spent less time naming our task groups.
translation: Vazifa guruhlariga nom berishga kamroq vaqt sarflasak, ko‘proq ish bajara olardik.

example: The design must fulfil the requirements, including the boring one about fitting through doors.
translation: Dizayn talablarga, jumladan, eshikdan sig‘ish haqidagi zerikarli talabga javob berishi kerak.

example: Implement the useful suggestion before it disappears into another meeting record.
translation: Foydali taklif yana bir bayonnomada yo‘qolmasidan uni joriy eting.

example: Perform the calculation before celebrating the astonishing result in your head.
translation: Xayolingizdagi hayratlanarli natijani nishonlashdan oldin hisobni bajaring.

example: Do not undertake a huge study simply because the title sounds impressive.
translation: Faqat sarlavhasi ta’sirli eshitilgani uchun ulkan tadqiqotga kirishmang.

example: We should pursue the useful lead rather than the amusing rumour.
translation: Qiziqarli mish-mish emas, foydali ma’lumot izidan borishimiz kerak.

example: Seek a clearer explanation before assuming the machine dislikes you.
translation: Uskuna sizni yoqtirmaydi deb o‘ylashdan oldin aniqroq izoh izlang.

example: Ensure the example answers the question rather than starting a new mystery.
translation: Misol yangi sir boshlamay, savolga javob berishini ta’minlang.

example: The benefits outweigh the drawbacks, although the drawbacks have a louder spokesperson.
translation: Afzalliklar kamchiliklardan ustun, ammo kamchiliklarning vakili balandroq gapiradi.
